darglobal.company: DarGlobal (Dar Global PLC), listed on the London Stock Exchange

whatsapp.note: The 'Chat with us on WhatsApp' link on every DarGlobal page, shown to visitors from the UAE, Saudi Arabia, the UK and the US.

phone.note: The 'Call' number the site shows to visitors from the US. Visitors from the UAE, Saudi Arabia and the UK were shown no phone number.

darglobal.register_interest: Every DarGlobal page has a 'Register Interest' form for enquiries about a project.
darglobal.not_found: No email address or office address appeared on the home, about or investor pages, and /contact and /contact-us return 404.

customer_service.note: Toll-free contact number Wasalt publishes in https://wasalt.sa/llms.txt.

wasalt.listing_contact: To reach the advertiser of a listing, open the listing's URL on wasalt.sa and use its call or WhatsApp buttons there.
wasalt.why_no_agent_numbers: Wasalt's AI policy disallows extracting phone numbers, WhatsApp links or contact details of listings, so this assistant stores none.
